responsibility: Declares the RTEMS-specific option metadata used by GCC’s option handling. It introduces qrtems and qnolinkcmds as driver options controlling RTEMS link/startfile behavior, and marks pthread as ignored in this environment. The file is declarative command-line metadata rather than the implementation of RTEMS specs.
same_name_distinction: This file is only the RTEMS option table, describing qrtems, qnolinkcmds, and ignored pthread handling for command-line decoding, whereas gcc/config/rtems.h contains the real RTEMS specs and compile/link policy that those options influence.
